what: Post-edit verification only greps `Default is \`bash\`` and `still uses bash`, but several live stale phrases use different wording.
scenario_or_breakage: An implementer can pass the plan’s grep check while `docs/configuration-and-permissions.md:191` still says `Set LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL=python` / `during the soak`, `AGENTS.md:9` still says `dev/CI-only until Phase 7`, and `python/README.md:15-20` still says `dev/CI-only until Phase 7` / `not wired into the live \`/implement\` path until Phase 7`.
suggested_fix: Expand the Testing strategy / Failure modes verification to one repo-wide sweep, e.g. `rg -n 'LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL|during the soak|still uses bash|dev/CI-only until Phase 7|not wired into the live' --glob '!larch-logs/**'` (or document the same patterns in the implement step), not only the two bash-default strings.
